proshares.definitionFact: Publisher glossary defines trailing price-to-earnings using collective component earnings for the most recent 12 months. Index page labels are generic Price/Earnings Ratio; this glossary does not establish every historical loss or extraordinary-item treatment.
proshares.collectionLimit: Most additional Wayback requests returned HTTP 429. Parallel collection was stopped; a later single legacy-PDF request also returned HTTP 429. No access control was bypassed.
proshares.selectionAssessment: Suitable as its own issuer-reported index valuation series at original dated observations; choose at most one observation per calendar quarter, preserve actual date and latest verified source vintage, and do not imply exact equivalence to other suppliers. No per-stock reconstruction is required to publish the issuer series.

selectionCriteria: The observation names the intended underlying index, not an ETF valuation.
Keep actual index as-of date separate from publication or archive capture time; match comparison dates exactly, identifying weekends separately.
Keep one named provider and earnings basis through the series, with source editions retained and known changes documented.
Treat raw weekly, monthly or quarterly frequencies as valid; never create daily interpolation or select fewer points because the curve looks smoother.
Retain original values and source bytes/hash; compare across independent publishers without declaring a mismatch erroneous when basis or vintage differs.
For percentiles, use one observation per intended period and explicitly report coverage; do not count repeated archived captures or mixed capture frequency as additional observations.
